description:
The file defines the 
Goteo\Model\Project PHP class, which manages project data in a crowdfunding platform including creation, retrieval, validation, updates, and relationships with other entities like rewards, costs, images, categories, and user access control.
It includes constants for project status, properties for project details, and methods for CRUD operations, validation, permissions, and related data fetching.
The class interacts extensively with a database via SQL queries to handle project lifecycle and related features.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a crowdfunding project with properties and methods to manage its lifecycle, relationships, validation, and permissions within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project with provided data, associating it with a user owner and a node, and handling default property assignments.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a full project record by ID, including related data like owner, categories, costs, rewards, images, and view-specific widget data.

methods.name: getMini
methods.description: Fetches minimal project data suitable for listing or overview without detailed relationships.

methods.name: getMedium
methods.description: Fetches medium-detail project data suitable for widget display, including owner info, categories, and images.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates core project fields for required values before saving into the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists project data and related entities like costs, rewards, categories, and images into the database after validation.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency exchange rate if needed, based on project currency configuration.

methods.name: setDays
methods.description: Calculates campaign rounds and remaining days based on publication date and campaign settings.

methods.name: userIsOwner
methods.description: Checks if a given user is the owner or co-owner of the project.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view the project based on status and roles.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to edit the project based on ownership, status, and permissions.

methods.name: userCanDelete
methods.description: Checks if a user can delete the project based on status and permissions.

methods.name: userCanModerate
methods.description: Determines if a user has rights to moderate or publish the project.

methods.name: userCanManage
methods.description: Checks if a user can manage the project, e.g., editing after approval.

methods.name: userCanAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if a user can perform administrative actions like updating sensitive info.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Retrieves the call instance if the project is associated with a call.

methods.name: getMatchers
methods.description: Returns matcher instances related to the project for matching purposes.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the User object of the project's owner.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Gets the account information related to the project.

methods.name: getInvestions
methods.description: Obtains a list of investors' investments in the project.

methods.name: getTotalInvestions
methods.description: Returns total investments in the project.

methods.name: getSocialRewards
methods.description: Fetches social (collective) rewards associated with the project.

methods.name: getIndividualRewards
methods.description: Fetches individual rewards for the project's investors.

methods.name: getSupports
methods.description: Retrieve all collaborations/supports related to the project.

methods.name: getAmountPercent
methods.description: Calculates percentage of the funding goal achieved.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the category names associated with the project.

methods.name: getDaysLeft
methods.description: Provides a human-readable countdown or due date status of the campaign.

methods.name: getStatusDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the project's current status.

methods.name: getStatusforMatcher
methods.description: Provides a string suitable for visual project status indicators.

methods.name: getConsultants
methods.description: Returns a list of user IDs who are consultants for the project.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the main image representing the project.

methods.name: getNumericId
methods.description: Converts the project alphanumeric ID into a numeric string based on hashing.

methods.name: inEdition
methods.description: Checks if the project is in an editable state.

methods.name: inReview
methods.description: Checks if the project is currently under review.

methods.name: inCampaign
methods.description: Checks if the project is actively in a campaign.

methods.name: isDraft
methods.description: Determines if the project is in draft state.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the project has been approved to proceed to funding.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the project is active and funded or in campaign.

methods.name: isDead
methods.description: Checks if the project is archived or not funded.

methods.name: isFunded
methods.description: Determines if the project has achieved funding goals.

methods.name: isFulfilled
methods.description: Checks if the project has fulfilled social return obligations.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if the project has reached minimum funding levels.

methods.name: getOpenTags
methods.description: Returns tags or categories associated with project visibility or grouping.

methods.name: assignOpen_tag
methods.description: Assigns a grouping or tag to a project.

methods.name: unassignOpen_tag
methods.description: Removes a grouping or tag from a project.

methods.name: setTagmark
methods.description: Determines a marker/label for the project based on its state or progress.

methods.name: getTagmark
methods.description: Returns the label/marker string for project status.
